title: Bar Series Strawberry Raspberry Blueberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Raspberry Blueberry by Bar Series is a bold mixed berry trio that combines sweetness, sharpness and depth in perfect harmony. Strawberry lays the foundation with bright, juicy notes, while Raspberry adds a tangy lift. Blueberry rounds off the blend with rich, jammy undertones, creating a full-bodied berry vape that's both vibrant and satisfying. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers a smooth, yet tactile throat hit and rapid nicotine uptake. It's blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits and starter devices. Explore Bar Series' wide range of flavours, which includes fruit blends, confectionery, icy menthols and many more exciting profiles crafted with extra-concentrated flavour for intense taste. Bar Series e-liquids cater to all vapers by offering 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nic salts designed to perform perfectly in your favourite pod kit.
